init_ThoughtlessLLMPlanner: initialize a ThoughtlessLLMPlanner with a plan config and environment interface for single-step planning
reset_planner: reset the ThoughtlessLLMPlanner state by clearing the prompt history and calling the parent reset
get_perception_tool_names: get the names of perception tools registered on a given agent instance
build_response_grammar: build a grammar string that accepts all valid tool call responses from a world graph
get_next_action: get the next low-level action for an agent given an instruction, observations, and world graph
